title: Prom and Yearbook
premise: Petra Coldharbour, a debate champion whose home is a war she keeps losing, is paired with her nemesis Theo Vance for a semester-long project: resurrecting the school's abandoned yearbook archive. As they reconstruct decades of forgotten students, Petra discovers a photo of a girl who looks exactly like her mother — and realizes the family story she's been living inside is built on an erasure. Winning the state debate championship becomes the only way to force the truth into the open, but the real victory comes when Petra chooses which version of herself, and which family, to claim. The book ends at prom, where Petra presents the finished yearbook — with her own found family written into its final pages.
about_author: Quentin Galloway spent six years as a high school forensics coach before trading flow pads for fiction. He writes stories about teenagers who argue their way into becoming themselves.

chapters.title: The Sentence
chapters.summary: Petra's POV. Opening days of senior spring: Petra counts down to graduation while losing every argument at home with her brittle, secretive mother. In debate class, Ms. Okafor pairs her with Theo Vance for a semester project restoring the school's sealed yearbook archive. Emotional beat: resentment sharpened into reluctant curiosity as Petra finds the first anomalous photo.

chapters.title: Nineteen Ninety-Eight
chapters.summary: Alternating POV between Petra and Theo. Digging through the archive, they uncover a redacted page and a girl named Rowan who vanished from school records mid-year — and who shares Petra's face. Their rivalry thaws into partnership over late nights in the archive room. Emotional beat: the thrill of shared conspiracy, and the first crack in Petra's certainty about her own history.

chapters.title: Cross-Examination
chapters.summary: Petra's POV, climax. Petra confronts her mother with the evidence on the eve of the state championship, detonating the family's carefully kept secret: Rowan was the aunt erased after a pregnancy scandal, and Petra was raised inside the silence. At the tournament, Petra abandons her prepared case to argue the truth itself — and wins. Emotional beat: fury transmuted into liberation.

chapters.title: Senior Will
chapters.summary: Theo's POV, resolution. Prom night: Theo and the debate team — Petra's found family — help her unveil the restored yearbook, dedicating its final pages to Rowan and to everyone the school forgot. Petra's mother arrives, fragile but present, and mother and daughter begin a truer argument. Emotional beat: grief settled into belonging; identity chosen, not inherited.
